description: Get the recorded metric streams of one completed session, whichever platform recorded it (parallel arrays: t = seconds from start, hr, speed m/s, elevation m, cumulative distance m, power W, and running dynamics where recorded), one sample every five seconds unless asked otherwise. Pass the session's workout_id; activity_id (the recording id) works too. To find a stretch — the slowest km, the 30 minutes with the lowest power — use find_session_windows.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

every.description: Seconds between samples. Default 5; 1 for the raw recording.

fields.description: Which arrays: hr, speed, elevation, distance, power, cadence, lat, lon… All by default; t always.

from_sec.description: Window start, seconds from the start of the recording.

workout_id.description: The session; its recording is found for you.

name: get_session_streams
